body:
The first round of feedback on 1.14.0, from device and browser testing: T-166
(web form layout), T-167 (pull to refresh), T-168 (Add bottom right, one look),
T-169 (closing beside leave, the lock notice), T-170 (Settings, not Account),
T-149 (update check on opening settings), T-171 (Reimburse), T-172 (the Expenses |
Balances selector). Minor version: several of these add behaviour, not only fixes.
title: Release 1.15.0
